people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”
translations.bsb: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, “I am afraid that harm might befall him.”
translations.kjv: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
translations.asv: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest Peradventure harm befall him.
